from datetime import datetime

# Retrieve cached hotel results
cached_hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Retrieve cached attraction results
cached_attractions = get_results_from_cache(key="attractions")

# Adjust check-out date based on check-in date and number of nights (13 nights)
check_in_date = "July 1, 2025"
check_out_date = adjust_date(date=check_in_date, delta_days=13)

# Filter hotels based on gym and wifi amenities
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=cached_hotels,
    gym_present=True,
    free_wifi_included=True
)

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Search for restaurants in St. Louis
restaurants = search_restaurants(
    city="St. Louis"
)

# Save restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="restaurants", value=restaurants)

# Search for attractions in St. Louis with type Cultural and name City Museum
attractions = search_attractions(
    city="St. Louis",
    type=["Cultural"],
    attraction_name=["City Museum"]
)

# Save attraction results to cache
save_to_cache(key="attractions", value=attractions)

# Find nearest hotels to the City Museum attraction
nearest_results = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    attractions=attractions,
    groupBy="attraction"
)

# Save nearest results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_hotels_to_city_museum", value=nearest_results)

# Print a summary of the planning
print("Hotel search completed with gym and wifi amenities.")
print("Restaurant search completed for St. Louis.")

print("Nearest hotels to City Museum identified.")
